title: Tenali Rama and the Empty Pot

scenes.summary: The king gives seeds to the courtiers.
scenes.text: The king gave seeds and asked everyone to grow plants in pots.
scenes.image_prompt: king giving seeds and pots to courtiers cartoon style

scenes.text: All courtiers grew plants, but Tenali’s pot remained empty.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali looking at empty pot while others have plants cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali tried but nothing grew, so he decided to present the empty pot honestly.
scenes.image_prompt: Tenali carrying empty pot to court cartoon

scenes.text: The king said the seeds were boiled and could not grow.
scenes.image_prompt: king explaining truth while courtiers look shocked cartoon

scenes.text: Tenali was declared the winner for being honest. Honesty is the best policy.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding Tenali while others look ashamed cartoon

story: The king gave boiled seeds that could not grow. While others cheated and showed plants, Tenali honestly brought an empty pot. The king rewarded him for his honesty.
